verdict.rationale: The Business & Liens portal home page states up front that filing goes through a credential account ('Sign In' / 'Create an Account'). It also explains what the Online Account does (multiple filings, 90-day transaction history, delivery info captured at creation). It notes that US Bank payment needs no separate registration ('Pay without Registering'). Together these disclose part of the account and credential path before a filer starts. Missing for 10: any published statement of identity-proofing or verification requirements (or an explicit statement that none apply), a consolidated pre-flow checklist of every account, credential and verification step for new-business filing, and independent or hands-on corroboration that no extra steps surface mid-flow.
